# MicroSplit AI
> MicroSplit AI is an intelligent revenue attribution and transparent settlement platform for modern developer squads, freelance consortiums, and distributed teams.

## Core Capabilities
- **Proof-of-Focus Attribution**: Quantifies actual contributions using objective signals (commits, pull requests, focus sessions, review rigor) instead of arbitrary percent guesses.
- **Multi-Currency Settlements**: Supports instant batch payouts in INR (₹), USD ($), EUR (€), GBP (£), CAD ($), and AUD ($).
- **One-Click PayPal Batch Payouts**: Direct integration with PayPal Payouts API v1 for instant member dispatches with idempotent run IDs.
- **Tamper-Evident Ledger**: Cryptographically verifiable SHA-256 state transitions and double-entry book balancing for every revenue split.
- **Cross-Timezone Collaboration**: Built-in support for global teams, including Indian Standard Time (IST), UTC, EST, PST, GMT, and JST.
